comment: ARCANUM WINGS' AURA SWAP IN COMBAT (USER 2026-10-05: 'this is actually important here'). Mother of Runes (1/1) wears Arcanum Wings; three untapped Seaside Citadels pay the {2}{U} swap; Colossification is in hand; the opponent is at 21. A MAIN-PHASE swap taps Mother (Colossification's ETB) and she cannot attack. The only kill: attack with Mother, then swap Colossification in AFTER attackers are declared -- the tap is then free (CR 506.4) and the +20 counts this combat: 1 + 20 = 21. Needs the searched Plan::combat_aura_swap_choice pin, the shared ApplyCombatAuraSwap in both combat worlds, and the damage-max swap pick choosing Colossification for an attacking host.
